newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends mostly higher, spec short covering.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends mostly higher, spec short covering.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended a quiet session mostly higher on Monday, led by new crop months on speculative short covering, traders said.
"Most of the volume was in the May/July spread," a floor trader said. "Short covering pushed new crop up."

Traders said cash markets were quiet, but some floor sources noted Jordan was tendering for 15,000 tonnes medium grain camolina rice for June delivery. They also cited reports China expects to import about 1.0 million tonnes of rice this year, according to the People's Daily Overseas Edition. China imported 760,000 tonnes of rice in 1996.
Rice ended eight cents per cwt higher to 2-1/2 cents lower with May unchanged at $11.50.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 400 lots, compared with Friday's actual volume of 598.
